Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove' Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another..

programme.title: 蜀山
programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil.

programme.title: 大丈夫日記
programme.desc: In this delightful screwball comedy, Chow Yun Fat plays a stock broker who met 2 women of his dream on the same night - boutique owner Joey (Joey Wang) and air stewardess Sally (Sally Yeh). Unable to say no to either one, he ended up marrying them both, one in New York and the other in Paris. When the wives befriended each other, he solicited the help from his buddy Hung (Waise Lee) to get him out of each tight spot.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband..

programme.title: 新龍爭虎鬥
programme.desc: Tiger, the older brother of Chinese Southern boxing champion Li Fung, was killed by Chow, a boxer of the rival Lung, during a boxing competition. Fung stayed in the boxing gym for handling his brother's funeral. Tiger's apprentice Nan and rogue Yin loved Fung at the same time. When Fung knew Nan fake a match to repay the boxing gym debt, she decided to bet on 300,000 dollars for a match with Chow. In the game, Fung killed Chow. Lung vowed to revenge, and captured Nan to threaten Fung for a final battle..

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..

They insured the diamond for a large sum of money then hired four gangsters to rob it in order to cheat the insurance company for the compensation. However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks..

programme.title: 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued..

programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: Taiwanese swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against Hong Kong swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan..

programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..

Fion is another classmate. She is addicted to chat in phone with friends and strangers every day. She always thinks she will find a true love from playing line. One day, she has an argument with her boyfriend on street, and Pat, an innocent girl, saw the incident..

She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..

programme.title: 上海假期
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 天才與白痴
programme.desc: Our story begins in the Hang Seng Sanitarium, which has a quite amount of crazy people. Ah Tim is a handy man there and Li is a nurse. Ah Tim has the greatest enthusiasm in his work, especially when he combs through the remains of the deceased and divests them of worldly items like gold fillings. However, his enterprise is spotted by Li, therefore, he has to make it a profit sharing venture. Later on, with the arrival of old Cheng, big fortune comes too. The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However..

programme.title: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..

programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 夜瘋狂
programme.desc: Teacher Wang is being held hostage one night by a bank robber in an all-night shop. Shop attendant Ling-ling and Wang struggle with the badly wounded robber, who dies in the fight. With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son..

programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us.

programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 霸王花
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out..

programme.title: 與龍共舞
programme.desc: Aaron, a young, successful Chinese businessman, drifts on to a rural island after a scuba accident. Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 衛斯理藍血人
programme.desc: Wesley is a member of the United Nation Aliens Analyzing Agency, and no stranger to extraterrestrial sightings. This time he finds himself face to face with Fong, a blue-blooded alien stranded on earth. Wesley and his girlfriend So promise to help Fong, but they must first combat FBI's powerful X Unit, who intends to capture Fong for their experiments. Making matters worse is the arrival of two aliens from Fong's home planet, determined to kill anyone that prevents them from retrieving their own species..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: 亡命鴛鴦
programme.desc: Crack policeman Hsiang Ming is having a talk with his separated wife when a bullet from hired killer Ah Chui kills the wife, an anti-drug policewoman. Hsiang Ming goes after the killer but is told to keep off by senior officer Lu. In fact, Lu is head of a narcotics ring and lover of Hsiang Ming's ex-wife. She knows his secret, thus Lu hires Ah Chui to kill her. Then Lu sets about to kill every one connected with crime-the go-between and Ah Chui. On his death bed, the go-between tells Hsiang Ming where to find Ah Chui. This Hsiang Ming does. But Lu's men are coming to kill both of them. Hsiang Ming has to fight off the attackers. Hsiang Ming takes Ah Chui to his mother-in-law's house where Ah Chui meets Hsiang Ming's daughter and feels shameful. When Lu's men come, she saves the young girl and an injured Hsiang Ming. As Hsiang Ming's friends fail to stop Lu, Ah Chui takes Hsiang Ming to a secret hide out and nurses him. They become lovers..

Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.desc: When a Hong Kong policewoman, a Japanese Interpol agent and an air security officer botch a plane hijacking attempt by a militia fanatic, his veteran friends vow revenge. In order to stop the terrorist attacks and also to save their own lives, the three heroes must team up once again to fight their gun-toting adversaries.

programme.title: 名劍
programme.desc: Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan..

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 小男人周記
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro..

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 急凍奇俠
programme.desc: Yuen Biao and Yuen Wah are two Ming Dynasty adversaries who topple into an ice chasm, only to be thawed out in modern day Hong Kong.

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.title: 芭啦芭啦櫻之花
programme.desc: Phillip Wong, a colour-blind dance instructor who is devoted to the Japanese Para Para. He meets Yee, a spoiled rich girl and an attraction begins to form between the two..

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 最佳拍檔之女皇密令
programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.title: 異度空間
programme.desc: Yan always sees dead people. Jim, her psychologist, thinks it's all in her mind brought by loneliness and by unpleasant experiences of past relationships. He devotes all his time to curing her. Jim soon falls in love as Yan is freed of her vision. But then he starts seeing dead people too. Jim remembers his past. His girlfriend in high school, named Yu, committed suicide when Jim tried to break up with her in twenty years ago. Now, with Yan's help and love, can Jim face up to the ghost and end the nightmare.

Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 衛斯理之霸王卸甲
programme.desc: This is a film about one of the practical metaphysics of the Orient - Geomancy. The Orientals believe fervently that a good burial site endows fame and fortune on its descendants. When the story begins, two geomancers are roaming Indochina's wilderness trying to find the dream grave site. They find The Conqueror, a site generating wealth and power - also a bloodbath. Nguen wants it but Wei wants no bloodbath. They have a fight. Wei escapes by the skin of his teeth. Wei rewards the poor man who saved him by finding him a good grave site. Many years later, Anna who is believed to be the daughter of the poor man, heads an American computer empire. Wei's son, Wisely, is a famous traveler. The girl asks him to go to Indochina to trace their roots..

programme.title: 安娜瑪德蓮娜
programme.desc: A romantic tale about 3 young people who starts out as adversaries and blossoms into something else. When a gorgeous female moves into the building and 2 men fall in love with her.

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 江湖龍虎鬥
programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Tensions reach boiling point as the celebrities face their toughest challenge yet. First, they navigate a powerful river to reach their camp, where they must build shelters and catch their supper without the usual army rations in sight. Then, a tropical storm strikes and water begins to flood the base, making for their worst night so far. The next morning, the contestants have to call on their newly acquired knot-tying skills to transform two unstable canoes into a catamaran and travel across to an island two miles away.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: As the remaining six celebrities pass the halfway point of the 12-day mission, they are starting to toughen up, but with one suffering from mosquito bites and another requiring treatment for trench foot, life in the jungle is beginning to take its toll. Arriving at a two-mile cave system, the contestants have to eat tarantulas' legs for breakfast, before using their rope skills to navigate the tight spaces and waterfall descents ahead, keeping a lookout for snakes, bats - and their dinner, a fresh pig carcass that Bear has hidden somewhere in the cave.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: Tensions reach boiling point as the celebrities face their toughest challenge yet. The next morning, the contestants have to call on their newly acquired knot-tying skills to transform two unstable canoes into a catamaran and travel across to an island two miles away.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive 第1季
programme.desc: As the remaining six celebrities pass the halfway point of the 12-day mission, they are starting to toughen up, but with one suffering from mosquito bites and another requiring treatment for trench foot, life in the jungle is beginning to take its toll. programme.title: The Force Of Nature 2022 第1季
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.desc: Space foods, initially created just for astronauts, has now facilitated a revolution in agricultural and alternative food production. This revolution is changing the way we think about producing food in the future. In Finland, protein-rich foods are produced from thin air, making food production possible in a variety of environments, including deserts, cities, and even outer space. Scientists in the United States are working to make mushroom cultivation more sustainable, while in Austria, seeds are exposed to space radiation to improve their yield when grown back on Earth. A startup in Singapore is using space technology to enhance the security of livestock herds, and at NUS, a team has developed a remarkable hydrogel that makes crop cultivation more water-efficient.

programme.title: Space Farmers 第1季
programme.sub-title: Food For Space Helps Planet Earth
programme.desc: How will research to live in space in the future benefit us on Earth today? In the Netherlands, we meet a team of researchers working with Martian and Lunar soil to grow crops and mealworms as food. In Thailand, scientists test the effects of varying gravity on the next superfood - watermeal. Meanwhile, an astounding transformation of agriculture is underway in Australia, with crop cultivation methods increasing output by 100%. With a cultivated beef firm in Israel racing to grow meat in space and a Singaporean company using microalgae to produce protein-rich foods, we learn how less is more for food production. Inspired by the similarity between disaster areas and outer space, a Japanese entrepreneur creates jellies to provide nutrition to earthquake victims and astronauts. As the space industry in Singapore grows, collaborations between countries and students’ interests in outer space deepen, leading to a transformation in space-for-humanity research.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -鉛筆

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -海綿

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沙漠花開
programme.desc: Four young adventurers discover how plants, animals and people survive in the harsh desert environment of Namaqua National Park in South Africa. The short rainy season has started and the desert is in full bloom.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.desc: Zoe is writing a card to a friend but is afraid of making spelling mistakes. Is there a country in this world with no spelling rules at all? To find out, our friends travel to China, where people don't use letters but ideograms.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅
programme.desc: Alim knows a few countries where it is common to have insects as part of your menu. Our heroes are a bit taken aback. They decide to go to Taxco in Mexico, where Felipe is waiting for them to hunt some bugs! Grilled, they are a local delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -塞內加爾之旅
programme.desc: Milo doesn't know what to do with his old broken skateboard. Zoe thinks it is useless, so it just needs to be thrown away, but Alim thinks otherwise. He knows that his friend Baidi can recycle anything and everything. Off they go to Senegal to meet Baidi.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴布亞紐幾內亞之旅
programme.desc: Milo battles with mosquitoes using an insecticide spray but realises he can't win. Our heroes decide to pay a visit to their penfriend in Papua New Guinea and learn how to co-exist alongside mosquitoes.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -殭屍化
programme.desc: Motor creates a new computer game whose addictiveness threatens the productivity of the entire world.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -生生不息
programme.desc: Eric uses a hula hoop to explore nature and create a special research area teeming with life. Using the hoop helps him identify, count and keep track of the tiny creatures and plants he finds.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -貝殻衫神木
programme.desc: Darwin, Newts and Heni work together to protect the big old kauri and keep it healthy.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -物體的重量
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts figure out by trial and error how to tell which can contains Heni's kitty's catfood.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -元素週期表

programme.title: 科學量販店 -微真菌學

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的長毛象
programme.desc: Ms. Bell has planned to surprise her students by hiding mammoth fossils in the school sandpit for them to dig up. But the surprise is on Ms. Bell and her students when the fossils disappear – and Addison has figure out where they went.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -可疑的圓圈之謎
programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -來跳舞吧
programme.desc: Gabi can't decide which animal impression to do for the annual talent show. Anabella suggests she dance like a ‘Bird of Paradise' and Gabi is intrigued. Why would a bird dance? To find out and get a video of the rarely-seen dance, the team flies to New Guinea.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -蒙蒂休假日
programme.desc: How could we have superpowers? The team flies off to Germany, to borrow some high-tech ‘super' suits. They try using a climbing suit, a jet pack and a powerlifting suit, but none is able to recover the Frisbee.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -塑膠杯
programme.desc: What could we make with a paper cup? Let's find out.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -罐頭

programme.desc: Dove is going through a rocky time with her horrible husband, Lord Roach. She consequently falls for Sir Howler. Despite being humble and loyal, Howler isn't always a paragon of finesse when it comes to winning the lady's heart or dealing with the jealous spouse.

programme.desc: Surfing the waves leads Kit and Mr. Battery into a dangerous storm.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -最大的動物
programme.desc: Mr. Battery collects photos of the largest animals, but he's still missing a photo of the mysterious giant squid.

She's determined to build her future in the land of fame and fortune.

長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：蘇諒徹底失望
programme.desc: 何有光不願坐以待斃，讓趙辛民發放荔枝股，先一步把這些利益給右相送過去。右相眼裏，誰能幫他斂財，誰才有價值。趙辛民來到廣場，憑藉三寸不爛之舌遊說眾人，打算發放荔枝股。蘇諒看到荔枝股，徹底失望.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 環球釣魚大冒險
快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄接受了一個任務，要運送三十個氣球給菲斯的表弟，但事情並不是想像中那麼容易.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》帶觀眾到訪札幌市手稻區的一間豆腐店。究竟多優質和精緻的豆腐，才能獲得日本第一的美譽？主持們亦會介紹各款健康的豆腐菜式，例如以豆渣代替肉碎的麻婆豆腐.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：肖春生為醫院購入復健器材
programme.desc: 肖春生來到康復中心看望昔日的病友，看到他們康復器材非常緊缺。肖春生來到佟曉梅的家裏，曉梅的父親知道了肖春生的玉器生意掙了不少錢，希望春生把錢用在正道上。肖春生告訴曉梅，自己想要為康復醫院做點事，他想要給醫院弄一些復健的器材。肖春生找陳宏軍幫忙介紹.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：醫院要求肖春生公司賠款
programme.desc: 肖春生創立春曉醫療，肖春生見曉梅的媽媽，他讓醫院免費試用他們的產品，醫院覺得效果好品質好再訂購。京西醫院下產品訂單，春曉醫療終於可以發工資。春曉醫療賣的貨品出現問題，醫院要求賠款，肖春生承诺還清賠款，並決定了不能依賴進口產品，他們要做自己的產品.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈： 琉森音樂節2017
守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 在珠江三角洲的傳統藝術中，手托木偶戲自光緒年間便紮根於香港，曾是廟會、醮會和盂蘭節的重要表演項目。「香港華山傳統木偶粵劇團」是香港最後一個手托木偶班，團主陳錦濤師傅一直守護著最後一批香港獨有的廣東手托木偶，而今年二十四歲的黃式瑜是陳師傅最年輕的徒弟，因緣際會愛上這門藝術。在厦村太平清醮這難得的十年一遇盛會中，她首次正式參與演出，見證了這門藝術的莊嚴與傳承.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: How did scientists embark on their journeys? What challenges and doubts have they come across along the way? These experiences are undoubtedly invaluable to future scientists aspiring to undertake scientific research. . The four laureates this year, Professor Xing XU, Professor Zhonghe ZHOU, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING, specially attended the talk “Dialogue with the Youth” for young people. They had close exchanges with Hong Kong secondary students from different schools, during which they delved into topics from palaeontology to forefront condensed matter physics, and shared their journeys of growth. The talk brought the Prize Week to a perfect close.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 何濼嬅天生患有耳骨硬化症，耳朵一邊聽不到聲音，另一邊借助助聽器也僅有5%的聽力。自幼與人溝通多是看口型，但藉著後天的努力練習，就算聽力有限，她說話十分清晰。長大後，她去學習西廚，特別喜歡整蛋糕，在過程中她得到了滿足感。. Hugo是社企創辦人，他留意到聽障婦女在工作時展現出細膩與專注，決定在一間超市內成立一間烘焙店，其中一位烘焙師就是何濼嬅，她每天早晨負責麵包的出爐、整形與包裝。在這無聲的環境中，烘焙師傅和街坊的互動如何？今集主持Marco吳祉昊會去探訪這些安靜細心的烘焙師.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念前往已更名為浦水的梅灣鎮調查，遇到從英國回來尋找失蹤母親的沈程，兩人互相猜疑。1991年，葉海棠因刺父事件被孤立，唐亦尋卻默默幫她還債、墊付班費，展現溫柔一面。兩人開始探究神秘郵筒的真相，葉海棠發現自己投入的「遺書」也不見了。同時，唐亦尋三兄弟因毆打追債人，面臨黑道報復.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：新上海灘
programme.desc: 年青軍官許文強(張國榮飾)被日軍追殺墮海,飄浮到外灘岸上,幸得丁力(劉德華飾)相救,不打不相識下結為好友.上海大亨馮敬堯(吳興國飾)利用二人剷除其他阻礙他的勢力,二人不虞有詐.強終發現當日在船上遭伏擊的幕後黑手乃馮敬堯,強抓起開信刀狂剌堯,程程(寧靜飾)不堪打擊成一瘋婦,力痛心不已,決先一步找出強算賬.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 龍仔（輕度智障），日復日地在倉庫工作，對於大多數人來說，這或許是一份單調而枯燥的工作，但在龍仔的世界裡，一切都有著自己的節奏與秩序。他用專注和堅持，將平凡的每一天過得充實且有條理。而主管Tommy不僅是龍仔上司，更是陪伴他成長的重要夥伴，一直以細心及耐性，在背後給予支持和鼓勵.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「病從口入」相信大家都聽過這句說話，但食物中毒卻常在我們日常生活中被忽略。根據衛生防護中心的數字，2025年就有129宗食物中毒個案，受影響人數達到682人；而今年截至3月10日，受影響人數已超過200人，當中細菌及病毒感染是導致食物中毒的主要原因。. 今集節目將會為大家探討一些經常導致食物中毒的病原體，以及它們常在哪些食物出沒，好讓大家減低食物中毒的風險。. 主持：黃婉曼、董光達醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生(中大醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)).

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念前往已更名為浦水的梅灣鎮調查，遇到從英國回來尋找失蹤母親的沈程，兩人互相猜疑。1991年，葉海棠因刺父事件被孤立，唐亦尋卻默默幫她還債、墊付班費，展現溫柔一面。兩人開始探究神秘郵筒的真相，葉海棠發現自己投入的「遺書」也不見了。同時，唐亦尋三兄弟因毆打追債人，面臨黑道報復.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶觀眾走進西班牙飲食文化的慢活世界。從早上的西班牙薯仔蛋餅及西班牙油炸鬼開始，探索一日五餐的從容生活哲學。之後我們會近距離欣賞西班牙火腿侍肉師的精湛刀工，了解火腿分級、藝術擺盤及品嚐秘訣；再向大廚們發掘西班牙小菜的歷史，以及飯後圍桌閒聊的社交禮儀。主持透過食物連結香港急速節奏與西班牙漫遊旅程，發掘熱情、誠實、分享背後的文化故事.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 板塊大碰撞撞出了青藏高原，同時也造就出了青藏高原上空的巨型「抽風機」。這個「抽風機」徹底顛覆了控制中國北緯30度上空的星際風系，印度洋和太平洋的水汽也被強力抽吸上高原，由此影響了中國、亞洲，甚至全球的氣候。在第二次青藏科考中，科學家探入從未到達的深空、掃描橫跨數千公里的超級渦流、追蹤異常降水帶、遠赴南海監測水汽路徑，期待揭開青藏高原上的空中祕境.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「病從口入」相信大家都聽過這句說話，但食物中毒卻常在我們日常生活中被忽略。根據衛生防護中心的數字，2025年就有129宗食物中毒個案，受影響人數達到682人；而今年截至3月10日，受影響人數已超過200人，當中細菌及病毒感染是導致食物中毒的主要原因。. 今集節目將會為大家探討一些經常導致食物中毒的病原體，以及它們常在哪些食物出沒，好讓大家減低食物中毒的風險。. 主持：黃婉曼、董光達醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生(中大醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)).

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 余市町是日本其中一個盛產生果的地方。他們現時出產18個品種。今次請來了兩位北海道模特兒來一起參與。收割過後，大家一起比較不同品種的特點。每一種都各具特色，味道、口感原全不一樣.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 兄妹倆都想獨佔房間，灶君利用神環相助，表面是幫他們解決煩惱，實際是想讓倆人反思並為對方着想；另一邊，灶君對落戶趙家心有不甘，準備偷偷換一家，卻因已掛名落戶，無法脫離趙家.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君原計劃向天庭申請調離趙家，天庭同意並派車接他。然而，住了幾日後，灶君逐漸對趙家產生感情，決定幫忙完成訂單上的元宵。沒想到，他坐錯車，不僅沒回天庭，還錯把湯圓送到天庭.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師在課堂上抽查菲菲背古詩，菲菲又出洋相。小鬱安慰她卻被菲菲遷怒，傷心地跑開。菲菲後悔想道歉，但小鬱失踪。如福幫忙找到了小鬱，菲菲誠心道歉，兩人和好.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 院子裡的地瓜乾消失了，為了找出偷吃賊，如福們守株待兔，發現地窖後隱藏的大空間，找到偷吃的地鼠阿疤和阿豁。夏美利用與動物溝通的能力，得知牠們在儲存冬糧.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在埃塞俄比亞，蜜蜂不僅僅是繁衍與豐饒的象徵，更承載著這個全球第二古老的基督教國家的信仰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在墨西哥，蜜蜂奉獻如此之多，以至於該國成為全球蜂蜜生產的領導者。蜜蜂激發了人們的尊敬與欽佩.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Hong Kong is riding a “pet‑friendly” wave. Malls, restaurants, and even public transport are opening to pets, reshaping city life and sparking new economic opportunities. The programme explores pet‑only mall floors, pet‑friendly transit, and expert views on how this trend could transform Hong Kong’s consumer landscape.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「心繫家國・絲路華彩 · 同心築夢」香港聖公會青少年西部國情研學活動分享會
programme.desc: 活動分享會由香港聖公會主辦，是該會舉行之系列活動第二站。參與學生從甘肅省交流回港，透過手機攝影比賽、行程匯報等項目分享他們在甘肅省研學的所見所聞.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: Turkey's Cultural Fusion in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Whether it's the traditional Turkish mosaic lamps or Turkish coffee, they both carry a rich history and culture, serving as a bridge for mutual understanding between Turkish and Hong Kong people. Two Turkish brothers, recognizing the business potential in Hong Kong, opened the first Turkish restaurant and introduced halal food practices.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：冰場上的兄弟重聚
programme.desc: 葉芳知道了陳宏軍和他的哥哥葉國華一起做生意，葉芳告訴陳宏軍不要害哥哥，兩個人為此大吵一架。來到二十一世紀，佟曉梅依然在醫院忙碌著，賀紅玲離開了舞臺，而葉芳和陳宏軍的關係幾近冰點，肖春生的事業蒸蒸日上，還把當年冰場上的兄弟都聚在春曉.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：葉國華觀摩肖春生的公司
programme.desc: 肖春生決定和葉國華的華盛集團合作，他帶葉國華來到他的公司觀摩。葉國華發現了肖春生的公司裏有好多他認識的兄弟。失聯的這些年，葉國華對於肖春生的一切一無所知，葉國華轉業後一直在心裏和肖春生較勁兒，不過肖春生從未把葉國華視為對手。葉國華回到家後越想越生氣.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「心繫家國・絲路華彩 · 同心築夢」香港聖公會青少年西部國情研學活動分享會
programme.desc: 活動分享會由香港聖公會主辦，是該會舉行之系列活動第二站。參與學生從甘肅省交流回港，透過手機攝影比賽、行程匯報等項目分享他們在甘肅省研學的所見所聞.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 十九世紀末，列強覬覦東北資源，俄國與日本先後在滿洲鋪設鐵路，以鋼軌劃分勢力範圍。從中東鐵路到南滿鐵道，車轍所至不僅運載旅客貨物，更承載帝國擴張的野心。鐵道沿線至今留存大量異國風格的車站與建築群。本集與觀眾走訪遼東大地，追溯滿洲鐵路的興建始末，透過沿途建築遺產，細說列強角力下東北近代的獨特歷程。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究)).

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 運動攀登近年從極限運動轉變成戶內及老少鹹宜的運動，並雲集各路攀登高手於奧運場上競技。備受港人關注的長洲搶包山亦是運動攀登中速度賽與難度賽的結合。. 香港足球運動員歐陽耀冲（歐冲）一向在綠茵場上奔跑，這次跟著六屆包山后學習跌、抱石、扭腰移動、跳躍等動作，甚至跟教練比拼速度賽！他能否憑藉運動員不服輸的拼勁贏得首次速度賽.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：奧菲歐與尤麗迪采
programme.sub-title: 奧菲歐與尤麗迪采 (上集)
programme.desc: 本劇講述奧菲歐痛失愛妻尤麗迪采後，毅然闖入冥界，誓言帶回妻子。愛神賜予他救贖的機會，卻設下「不可回頭」的嚴苛條件。奧菲歐歷經怨靈阻攔、冥界幻景，終與尤麗迪采重逢，卻在返回人間的最後關頭，因妻子的悲傷質疑而絕望回首，導致永別。最終愛神為其深情所動，讓愛人重生，見證真愛超越生死。歌劇片段由香港非凡美樂提供。. 藝術總監：盧景文. 監製及導演：梁笑君. 指揮：杜洛沙. 演出：. 李卓麟. 金雅修. 沈喜詠. 鄧思寧、文浚彥. Rebaroque Orchestra. 非凡美樂合唱團.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.sub-title: 泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.desc: 泛亞交響樂團成立接近五十年，創辦人葉惠康博士一直擔任樂團音樂總監及指揮，以推廣音樂給市民大眾為理念，演出逾幾百場音樂會。《演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團凌顯祐．新世界》其實是年逾九十的葉博士交棒予新任樂團音樂總監凌顯祐的莊嚴儀式。葉、凌二人在台上分享了他們的深厚情感，觀眾無不動容。. 音樂會上半場，凌顯祐邀請了兩位他在香港管弦樂團的同袍–單簧管首席史安祖、及低音單簧管手艾爾高演出，兩位樂手在樂曲的表現上發揮高超的技巧而充滿玩味感。音樂會的標題「凌顯祐‧新世界」與下半場樂團演出的德伏扎克E小調第九交響曲，又名「新世界交響曲」，兩者互相呼應，觀眾可見證新總監凌顯祐如何傳承葉博士的音樂理念，帶領樂團提升到另一新境界。音樂會片段由泛亞交響樂團攝製及提供。. 曲目：. 1.龐吉耶利：單簧管二重奏及樂隊的作品. 2.孟德爾遜：為單簧管，巴塞管及樂隊而寫的音樂會作品第一首. 3.德伏扎克：E小調第九交響曲，「新世界.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 有一位小鄰居發現家中突然出現一個神秘的綠色信封，之後更察覺爸爸的態度開始有些不同。原本爸爸答應，只要他考試成績理想，就帶他去主題樂園玩和吃大餐，沒想到現在竟然食言！Harry 哥哥覺得事情並不簡單，於是決定到學校一探究竟。與此同時，貓頭鷹博士登場，為大家解開疑團，指出這件事與《基本法》有關。面對個人利益與整體社會責任之間，我們又應該如何取捨呢？. 《基本法》第四十二條：. 香港居民和在香港的其他人有遵守香港特別行政區實行的法律的義務。. 《基本法》第一百零八條：. 香港特別行政區實行獨立的稅收制度。香港特別行政區參照原在香港實行的低稅政策，自行立法規定稅種、稅率、稅收寬免和其他稅務事項。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第四集：我想給你一個晴天，但我只有一把烏雲做的傘
programme.desc: 1991年，唐亦尋三兄弟的檯球屋被黑道砸毀，買船錢也被搶走。葉海棠在家遭受父親暴打，為唐亦尋包紮傷口時，兩個傷痕累累的靈魂終於靠近。他們夜守郵筒，發現葉海棠投進去的「遺書」竟憑空返回。2026年，沈程與余念為郵筒的真偽爭執不休，張泉卻在午夜將「遺書」扔進了郵筒，觸發了奇蹟.

周末大電影 : 冰風暴
programme.desc: In the 1970's decade, a suburban Connecticut couple grapples with infidelity and personal dissatisfaction while their teenage children seek sexual freedom. The eventful Thanksgiving weekend makes them take a hard look at their lives.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: How did scientists embark on their journeys? What challenges and doubts have they come across along the way? These experiences are undoubtedly invaluable to future scientists aspiring to undertake scientific research. . The four laureates this year, Professor Xing XU, Professor Zhonghe ZHOU, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING, specially attended the talk “Dialogue with the Youth” for young people. They had close exchanges with Hong Kong secondary students from different schools, during which they delved into topics from palaeontology to forefront condensed matter physics, and shared their journeys of growth. The talk brought the Prize Week to a perfect close.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 運動攀登近年從極限運動轉變成戶內及老少鹹宜的運動，並雲集各路攀登高手於奧運場上競技。備受港人關注的長洲搶包山亦是運動攀登中速度賽與難度賽的結合。. 香港足球運動員歐陽耀冲（歐冲）一向在綠茵場上奔跑，這次跟著六屆包山后學習跌、抱石、扭腰移動、跳躍等動作，甚至跟教練比拼速度賽！他能否憑藉運動員不服輸的拼勁贏得首次速度賽.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第四集：我想給你一個晴天，但我只有一把烏雲做的傘

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Hong Kong is riding a “pet‑friendly” wave. Malls, restaurants, and even public transport are opening to pets, reshaping city life and sparking new economic opportunities. The programme explores pet‑only mall floors, pet‑friendly transit, and expert views on how this trend could transform Hong Kong’s consumer landscape.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: Turkey's Cultural Fusion in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Whether it's the traditional Turkish mosaic lamps or Turkish coffee, they both carry a rich history and culture, serving as a bridge for mutual understanding between Turkish and Hong Kong people. Two Turkish brothers, recognizing the business potential in Hong Kong, opened the first Turkish restaurant and introduced halal food practices.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在埃塞俄比亞，蜜蜂不僅僅是繁衍與豐饒的象徵，更承載著這個全球第二古老的基督教國家的信仰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在墨西哥，蜜蜂奉獻如此之多，以至於該國成為全球蜂蜜生產的領導者。蜜蜂激發了人們的尊敬與欽佩.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：七連對敵發動猛烈攻勢
programme.desc: 雷公帶炮排沖鋒，萬里展示投彈天賦，用手榴彈炸毀美軍坦克。梅生駕車率七連突破雷區，發起猛烈攻勢，北極熊團潰散。七連炮排遭到美軍的炮火轟擊，迫擊炮支架被炸斷，身受重傷的長喜以身體作為支撐，大壯含淚作戰。漢斯請求反擊未果，上校逃避戰局.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 莊超英對孩子發火
programme.desc: 莊超英叫孩子到祖父母家一趟，兩個人都不太願意，找各種藉口推來推去。莊超英非常生氣，一怒之下揮手打了筱婷一巴掌。鵬飛說祖父母曾恐嚇筱婷，說過如果他們學習成績不好，父母就要離婚。林武峰來信了，讓莊圖南和林棟哲一起去廣州，初到廣州，莊圖南目不暇接.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集: 莊圖南畢業後的選擇
programme.desc: 在廣州的林棟哲想起了從小和莊筱婷長大的點點滴滴，十分想念她。林棟哲打電話給筱婷，說決定跟她報同一所大學，莊筱婷聽了也很高興。莊圖南畢業後會分配回蘇州工作，但他想讀研究班。莊超英覺得讀了研也不一定能留在上海，他和黃玲希望莊圖南能找一份安穩的工作.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集嘉賓伍經衡，幼時英語成績欠佳，差點兒「考包尾」。然而，老師的一句勉勵之言，卻徹底改變了他的人生軌跡。自此，他投身教育事業，先後任教、創辦補習社，並於退休之年完成博士學位，更榮獲「最佳博士論文獎」。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 嘉賓：. 伍經衡(補習社創辦人). #補習老師#義教#博士#Richard Eng #學海無涯.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄正在執行任務，但阿菇掉進了一個神秘的洞穴裡，而洞穴裡的小蘑菇們竟然把他當作國王….

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主持人會學習以北海道食材，製作豆沙餡料。豆沙餡的款式包羅萬有，有粒粒豆沙、綿滑豆沙，亦有分紅豆製和白腰豆製的！另外，他們還嘗試製作豆沙包，不知味道如何呢.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：何有光赴約鴻門宴
programme.desc: 何有光命令將高州封城，魚常侍毫無懼色，約何有光赴約鴻門宴。魚朝恩揭開了何有光的野心，以及背後真正的主人。當年何有光取代海虎到長安，投靠貴人，蟄伏在高州隨時待命.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 藝術無界限，一眾展能藝術家除了表演自己專長的藝術項目，亦在彼此藝術範疇以外作出新嘗試，今次是「做戲」！展能藝術家趙惠芝和李昇，會和主持Angel梁安琪、富爸爸岑幸富分享他們今次的藝術經歷。展能藝術家伍惠娟會和沙畫藝術家胡藹的一同傾下彼此藝術交流的樂趣和故事.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 鮮豔的顏色層次、衝擊的味覺體驗，泰菜的魅力席捲亞洲。主廚Art Sinlaparkorn在本集會分享泰國料理中酸、辣、鹹、甜的精妙平衡，以及自己的烹飪哲學。兒時受祖母啟發，令他醉心於泰國料理的藝術，踏上成為廚師之路。Chef Art將從小到大嘗遍的泰國地道風味，直接複製到香港；更邀請主持Andy Dark細嚐青木瓜沙律、醉貓炒河、泰式椰子煎餅等街頭美食。. 離開家鄉追隨夢想，Chef Art幸運地在香港遇上他的「另一半」。他們與一班同鄉好友，慢慢在香港建立另一個「家」.

programme.title: 31 看世界 - 物種大滅絕
programme.desc: 印度住了約27,000隻亞洲象，擁有全世界最大型的亞洲象群落。雖然印度能每日為每隻亞洲象提供450公斤食物，但牠們的存活卻面臨威脅。亞洲象對高溫敏感，炎熱天氣可引發牠們出現代謝症候群、氧化壓力、免疫抑制反應，甚至死亡，而影響繁殖率。目前印度境內有約42%的亞洲象棲息地，因為人為壓力和氣候變化夾擊而消失。. 印度環境、森林及氣候變化部門和一眾動物專家，正努力創建環保通道，協助大象暢通無阻地搬家。我們一於隨著專家和本地居民，去看看這些亞洲象能否在氣候變化威脅之下倖存下來。. India is home to approximately 27,000 Asian Elephants, which is the world’s largest population of the species. The country may be the species’ main stronghold, helping each elephant consume 450 kg of food every day. But its survival is now under threat. . Their sensitivity to heat leads to metabolic disorders, oxidative stress, immune suppression, and death, impacting their reproduction rates. Some 42% of the present available habitat in the country will be lost due to the combined effects of human pressure and climate change. . The elephants are likely to shift towards higher elevations in the Himalayas. We follow animals’ activists along with the Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change in India who are battling to create a green corridor to help them to travel and shift habitats without issue and give legal protection to the movement of elephants. . Can the Asian elephant survive these modern threats to its existence.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：余從戎犧牲伍萬里崩潰
programme.desc: 在新興里的戰鬥中，七連繳獲了北極熊團的團旗，但也付出了慘重的代價，僅剩半個連。余從戎為保護萬里而犧牲，萬里悲痛欲絕。團長命令七連迅速穿越長津湖冰面，佔領死鷹嶺高地，阻擊南下的美軍。五連的大壯堅決要求留在七連報仇.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31 看世界 - 物種大滅絕
programme.desc: 印度住了約27,000隻亞洲象，擁有全世界最大型的亞洲象群落。雖然印度能每日為每隻亞洲象提供450公斤食物，但牠們的存活卻面臨威脅。亞洲象對高溫敏感，炎熱天氣可引發牠們出現代謝症候群、氧化壓力、免疫抑制反應，甚至死亡，而影響繁殖率。目前印度境內有約42%的亞洲象棲息地，因為人為壓力和氣候變化夾擊而消失。. 印度環境、森林及氣候變化部門和一眾動物專家，正努力創建環保通道，協助大象暢通無阻地搬家。我們一於隨著專家和本地居民，去看看這些亞洲象能否在氣候變化威脅之下倖存下來。. India is home to approximately 27,000 Asian Elephants, which is the world’s largest population of the species. The country may be the species’ main stronghold, helping each elephant consume 450 kg of food every day. But its survival is now under threat. . Their sensitivity to heat leads to metabolic disorders, oxidative stress, immune suppression, and death, impacting their reproduction rates. Some 42% of the present available habitat in the country will be lost due to the combined effects of human pressure and climate change. . The elephants are likely to shift towards higher elevations in the Himalayas. We follow animals’ activists along with the Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change in India who are battling to create a green corridor to help them to travel and shift habitats without issue and give legal protection to the movement of elephants. . Can the Asian elephant survive these modern threats to its existence.

programme.sub-title: 第二十四集: 林棟哲與莊筱婷再做同學
programme.desc: 莊圖南與李佳畢業聚會就要分開了。林棟哲真的考上了莊筱婷同一所上海的大學，他返回蘇州親自告訴莊筱婷這個好消息。黃玲表示宋瑩要是在的話，一定要敲鑼打鼓昭告天下。向鵬飛高考成績不理想，他母親希望他重讀考大學，求哥哥莊超英繼續收留鵬飛，不過鵬飛已另有打算.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集: 林棟哲嫌莊圖南破壞約會
programme.desc: 林棟哲約了莊筱婷看電影，等了很久都沒有等到她，原來莊圖南來了探妹妹，林棟哲想要讓莊圖南趕緊走。鄰居張阿妹想要住在宋瑩空著的房子，對人說宋瑩把房子租給她，但黃玲覺得宋瑩不可能不告訴自己把房子租出。新政策下林武峰可以回去蘇州的單位了，但林武峰並不願意.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 為進一步推動粵港澳大灣區的文化交融，深圳市前海管理局與香港電台聯合主辦「學人沙龍——影視創新天」深圳前海特別企劃。並邀請兩位在不同階段參與影視製作的監製級人物楊盼盼與林子聰，共同探討深港文化交流與影視產業合作的新機遇。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 楊盼盼(演員、動作指導、監製). 林子聰(演員、監製). #前海#影視創新天#灣區之眼#文化交流#新機遇.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 赫伯特發明了一頂不實用的「降溫帽子」，卡通動畫有趣兒童輕鬆並遭受謎語大師的嘲笑，然而最後他卻用這頂帽子拯救了世界.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 瀧川市擁有領先日本的油菜種植園區。農民會在露天的田播種，在溫室收割。命名「雪割油菜」的農夫，2009年時曾出演本節目。油菜農民太太煮的菜式相當美味.

programme.sub-title: 與安達盧西亞牛仔同行
programme.desc: 維克托將會躍上馬背，展開這趟挑戰旅程。他先跟隨馴馬師學習，再前往法蘭琪-康堤寄宿於一個「牛仔之家」，藉此裝備自己，為參與西班牙安達盧西亞歷史悠久的「雌馬出巡」習俗做好準備。. 屆時，維克托會與一眾安達盧西亞傳奇野馬牧人並肩，護送上千匹野生雌馬，從多尼亞納國家公園出發，跨越威爾瓦的廣袤田野，前往阿爾蒙特。這次旅程彷彿穿越時空，帶領觀眾走入一個以馬為尊的世界.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：真假方瑾同時出現
programme.desc: 方謹得知是蘇橙橙用濾鏡手鐲變成自己的樣子幫助了自己，心中感激。方謹成功離婚，並和唐奇的公司成功簽約。唐奇為自己對方謹的情感感到困惑，再次去實驗室找方謹，卡在方謹形象上的蘇橙橙正與方謹在實驗室研究新品的改進。唐奇突然到來，兩個方謹再次機智地嚇住了唐奇.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集: 姍姍不滿爸爸不讓弟弟上高中
programme.desc: 鄰居老吳的女兒姍姍當年犧牲了自己不報讀高中考大學，現在父母又不讓弟弟小軍上高中。小軍覺得讀技校也不錯，姍姍表示小軍還不明白，林棟哲他們上大學了，姐弟和他們之間的差距越來越大了。有一天，莊圖南見到林棟哲和莊筱婷牽手，非常震驚，沒想到他們居然在一起了.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集: 物價飆升搶購商品
programme.desc: 物價漲得非常快，林武峰讓宋瑩去把錢拿出來買黃金。莊圖南跟教授做醫院的項目，與規劃局的李佳碰面。莊圖南要跟林棟哲和向鵬飛去做生意，莊超英不同意，覺得莊圖南應該好好學習。莊圖南覺得家裡有困難的時候自己沒支持十分內疚，黃玲把家裡的錢交給莊圖南，支持他去做.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 巨鷹卡拉和英雄們一起探險，每次都能協助他們取得成功。不過，冰冰覺得這樣的探險很無聊，並在團隊需要卡拉時得罪了他.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》主持人會到訪一個育有七子一女的十人大家庭，看看他們如何經營酪農農場。十三年前，夫婦二人從東京來到大樹町，展開務農生活.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：魚常侍派人殺李善德
programme.desc: 魚常侍派白望入去殺李善德，趕巧被鄭平安撞見了，為了讓李善德帶着袖兒有時間逃離，鄭平安攔下了白望人，卻倒在了血泊中。鄭平安奄奄一息，說自幼膽小，今日能為保護家人勇敢一回。桂花樹宛若盛放，李善德和袖兒究竟能躲過了這一劫嗎.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：濾鏡手鐲再次升級
programme.desc: 方謹在蘇橙橙等人的鼓勵下，終於自信地在發佈會上介紹了自己的專利。發佈會結束後，唐奇遇見由蘇橙橙變身的方謹，兩人一起看着彩虹，她的一番談話，引得唐奇動情告白，假方謹落荒而逃。此時，濾鏡再次升級完成，蘇橙橙一覺醒來發現自己變身成林媛畫出來的男人全勝唐.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 作為香港經濟支柱之一的零售業，近年漸見殘疾僱員的身影在其中。在競爭激烈的零售市場當中，不難發現『講金又講心』的溫暖故事。. 售賣咖啡產品的小型連鎖店老闆Gigi，十多年來堅持聘請殘疾人士為員工。. 品牌目前有四間實體店舖，員工人數不多，但其中一半為殘疾人士。當中聾人咖啡師，以及被確診患有專注力不足的烘焙師，除專注在本身的崗位，Gigi近年更安排他們在店舖以及市集擔任銷售員，訓練他們多接觸群眾，練習與人溝通、管理等技巧，帶望他們在能在日後的求職路上更有競爭力。. Gigi更經常鼓勵、安排員工參與本地及國內外的手冲咖啡及烘焙比賽，期望可在小小的咖啡零售店以外，帶領員工踏上更廣闊的舞台，拓闊視野。. 成立二十多年的社企公司，目前有超過七成的員工為精神病康復者。公司旗下業務眾多，零售業為當中主要業務之一，轄下除擁有售賣復康用品的自家品牌店及餐廳，近年更開始跟慈善基金合作，開展便利店的業務。. 曾患思覺失調的康復者，以及患有阿氏保加症的員工，分別擔任便利店店員以及送貨員，其家人、上司、社工等的輔導跟協助，成為他們最強的後盾。. 本集幾位於零售業打拼的殘疾人士，在求職及工作的路上，透過自身努力突破障礙，勇敢挑戰自我.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 巴巴多斯、聖文森特格林納丁斯都是較少人認識的加勒比島嶼，位於南美次大陸附近。它們被稱為「風向群島」，如同頸鏈上的珍珠。當地的原居民是美洲印第安人的後裔，後來，部分與歐洲人及非洲奴隸血統混合。如今，當地人已經掌握悠閒的生活方式.

programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：魚常侍派人殺李善德

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.desc: 方謹在蘇橙橙等人的鼓勵下，終於自信地在發佈會上介紹了自己的專利。發佈會結束後，唐奇遇見由蘇橙橙變身的方謹，兩人一起看着彩虹，她的一番談話，引得唐奇動情告白，假方謹落荒而逃。此時，濾鏡再次升級完成，蘇橙橙一覺醒來發現自己變身成林媛畫出來的男人全勝唐.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 巴巴多斯、聖文森特格林納丁斯都是較少人認識的加勒比島嶼，位於南美次大陸附近。它們被稱為「風向群島」，如同頸鏈上的珍珠。當地的原居民是美洲印第安人的後裔，後來，部分與歐洲人及非洲奴隸血統混合。如今，當地人已經掌握悠閒的生活方式.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 巨鷹卡拉和英雄們一起探險，每次都能協助他們取得成功。不過，冰冰覺得這樣的探險很無聊，並在團隊需要卡拉時得罪了他.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》主持人會到訪一個育有七子一女的十人大家庭，看看他們如何經營酪農農場。十三年前，夫婦二人從東京來到大樹町，展開務農生活.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十六集：遇上工程專家馮辛
programme.desc: 在冰天雪地中，七連艱難跋涉，途中重傷戰士相繼犧牲。萬里目睹戰友離去，迅速成長。途中遇到逃亡的工程專家馮辛，誤以為是逃兵，後知其正協助三連作戰。七連受命增援三連，與美軍激烈交火。三連連長告知七連，必須摧毀美軍退路水壩橋，阻止敵軍撤退.

programme.desc: 林棟哲和莊圖南跟林棟哲的叔叔及表哥一起做生意，莊圖南看好賣錄音機，在南方找好了門路，把貨運到江蘇去，與鵬飛去鄉鎮那邊賣貨。宋瑩已經聽有人說林棟哲跟莊筱婷拍拖，林武峰表示黃玲非常寶貝莊筱婷，這句話可別讓黃玲聽見了.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十九集: 姍姍硬要住進宋瑩的房子
programme.desc: 青浦大橋方案由莊圖南的大學負責，施工方想省錢，但大學認為安全不容忽視。莊超英父親受傷，想接父母來住在宋瑩的房子，黃玲和向鵬飛不同意，莊很不高興。姍姍與副廠長兒子婚，副廠長逼宋瑩租出整間房子給姍姍，鵬飛使計保住了一半房子。莊圖南到工地遇到意外暈了過去.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了環保協進會創立人及行政總監邱榮光博士，以及環保協進會鳳園蝴蝶保育區項目總監(自然保育)趙玉蓮女士，分享有關香港蝴蝶的生態知識。本集以紅珠鳳蝶、裳鳳蝶、燕鳳蝶作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索不常見蝴蝶的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: As one of the pillars of Hong Kong's economy, the retail industry has increasingly seen the presence of disabled employees in recent years. In the fiercely competitive retail market, it is easy to find heartwarming stories of compassion and commitment. . Gigi, the owner of a small chain of coffee shops, has insisted on hiring people with disabilities for over a decade. The brand currently operates four physical stores, with a small number of employees, half of whom are disabled. Among them are a deaf barista and a baker diagnosed with attention deficit disorder. Aside from focusing on their roles, Gigi has also arranged for them to work as sales staff at the stores and markets, training them to interact more with the public and practice skills in communication and management, hoping to make them more competitive in their future job searches. . Gigi often encourages and arranges for employees to participate in local and international hand-brewed coffee and baking competitions, aiming to lead them onto a broader stage beyond their small coffee retail store to expand their horizons. . Founded over twenty years ago, the social enterprise currently employs over 70% of its staff as mental health recoverers. The company operates various businesses, with retail being one of its main sectors. It includes its own brand store selling rehabilitation products and restaurants. . Recoverers who have suffered from schizophrenia , as well as employees with attention deficit disorder, work as convenience store staff and delivery personnel, with support and guidance from their families, supervisors, and social workers acting as their strongest backing. . In this episode, several individuals with disabilities striving in the retail industry overcome obstacles and bravely challenge themselves through their efforts in seeking employment and working. Today’s guest, Ng Hoi Yan, will experience firsthand the working conditions of disabled employees in the retail sector.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: As one of the pillars of Hong Kong's economy, the retail industry has increasingly seen the presence of disabled employees in recent years. In the fiercely competitive retail market, it is easy to find heartwarming stories of compassion and commitment. . Gigi, the owner of a small chain of coffee shops, has insisted on hiring people with disabilities for over a decade. The brand currently operates four physical stores, with a small number of employees, half of whom are disabled. Among them are a deaf barista and a baker diagnosed with attention deficit disorder. Aside from focusing on their roles, Gigi has also arranged for them to work as sales staff at the stores and markets, training them to interact more with the public and practice skills in communication and management, hoping to make them more competitive in their future job searches. . Gigi often encourages and arranges for employees to participate in local and international hand-brewed coffee and baking competitions, aiming to lead them onto a broader stage beyond their small coffee retail store to expand their horizons. . Founded over twenty years ago, the social enterprise currently employs over 70% of its staff as mental health recoverers. The company operates various businesses, with retail being one of its main sectors. It includes its own brand store selling rehabilitation products and restaurants. . Recoverers who have suffered from schizophrenia , as well as employees with attention deficit disorder, work as convenience store staff and delivery personnel, with support and guidance from their families, supervisors, and social workers acting as their strongest backing. . In this episode, several individuals with disabilities striving in the retail industry overcome obstacles and bravely challenge themselves through their efforts in seeking employment and working. Today’s guest, Ng Hoi Yan, will experience firsthand the working conditions of disabled employees in the retail sector.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #7 A Boon for Keeping Warm – Lamb
programme.desc: When talking about nourishing foods for the winter, lamb is often the first thing that comes to mind. Mutton is rich in protein and iron, making it highly beneficial for enriching the blood. However, as for the unique and strong “gamey smell” of mutton, some people love it while others find it off-putting. While we usually choose imported or Mainland mutton, black lambs are also bred in Hong Kong. In this episode, the “Food Fanatics” visit a farm where hundreds of black lambs are raised to explore their properties and habits. The chef host Mabel also creates a specially designed dish, “Crown Roast of Lamb with Lemon and Fermented Tofu, teaching us how to remove the gamey odor while preserving the tenderness of mutton. We also invited the news presenter Ruby LAM to share her tips for staying in shape; and the registered Chinese medicine practitioner CHO Shun-yan to explain the properties of lamb, including who should eat it and how to enjoy it in a nourishing way without causing "internal heat”. . Hosts: Yuki LAW, Mabel (Resident Chef). Guests: Ruby LAM, CHO Shun-yan (Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 地球大堡礁
programme.desc: Whales, manta rays, whale sharks are all eaters of animal plankton or small fish, themselves huge consumers of vegetable plankton. These marine algae produce half of the oxygen on earth and capture 40% of the carbon dioxide.But the global role of the Mastodonts is hardly believable. By swallowing plankton and the small animals that feed on them, these giants capture and store carbon in their fat. When they die, they sink into the abyss where the carbon remains trapped for thousands of years. For example, one whale captures as much carbon each year as a thousand trees. These giants are real allies in regulating the climate and restoring reef productivity. The programme for identifying these new feeding areas is easily reproducible in all the areas concerned around the world.
